title: aerangis articulata
intro: Aerangis articulata, commonly known as the "Horned Aerangis" or "Venus Slipper Orchid," is a species of orchid native to Madagascar. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aerangis articulata include promoting wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
